import MeasureTheory.Measure
import ProbabilityTheory.CumulantGeneratingFunction
import Analysis.AnalyticFunction

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory

theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} : AnalyticOn ℝ (ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ) (interior (ProbabilityTheory.integrableExpSet X μ)) := by
  let S := interior (integrableExpSet X μ)
  let h_S_nonempty : S ≠ ∅ := by simp [integrableExpSet, interior, isOpen_interval]
  let h_exp_integrable : ∀ t ∈ S, ∫⁻ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ < ∞ := by
    intro t ht
    exact (integrableExpSet X μ).mem_iff.mp ht
  let h_mgf_diff : ∀ t ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => ∫⁻ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ) t := by
    intro t ht
    refine (differentiable_at_lintegral_exp X μ t ht).mpr _
    apply continuous_at_of_continuous_of_open_ball
    apply continuous_lintegral_exp X μ
  let h_log_analytic : ∀ t ∈ S, AnalyticAt ℝ (fun t => log (∫⁻ ω, exp (t * X ω) ∂μ)) t := by
    intro t ht
    refine (analytic_at_log (h_exp_integrable t ht) (h_mgf_diff t ht)).mpr _
    apply analytic_at_lintegral_exp X μ t ht
  exact h_log_analytic
